part.name: TAPER PIN
part.material: MAT'L: STEEL LASALLE STRESS PROOF OPT'L: SAE 4140, 5132 OR 8640 (30-38 Rc) MIN YIELD 100,000 PSI OPT'L: ASTM A311 CLASS B GRADE 1141/1144 MIN YIELD 100,000 PSI

coordinate_system.orientation_notes: X follows the pin centerline and dominant turning axis. +X points toward the right end face and internal threaded bore; -X points toward the left external thread. The main view looks along -Z with Y vertical. The end-view plane is YZ. Datum A establishes the longitudinal axis but does not establish an axial zero.

features.name: Thread relief undercut
features.description: Annular undercut/relief groove between the 1.250-12 thread and the tapered section.

geometry.position_description: At junction between cylindrical shank and tapered body

features.name: Permissible lathe center hole
features.description: Lathe center hole indicated by concentric dashed circles at the center axis of the pin end face with note 'CENTERS PERMISSIBLE'.

geometry.position_description: Centred on the primary longitudinal axis of the pin

features.name: Left end chamfer
features.description: Outer entry chamfer at the left end of the 1.250-12 UNF external thread.

features.name: Left external thread
features.description: UNF external thread on the left pin spindle with true position control relative to Datum A.

features.name: External tapered shaft section
features.description: Conical shaft section with 1.50 in/ft taper, specified gage diameter, and runout control to Datum A.

features.name: Taper-to-body shoulder fillet
features.description: Transition radius between the large end of the taper and the main cylinder body.

features.name: Main cylindrical body (Datum A)
features.description: Large outer cylindrical journal of the pin, defining primary Datum A, including an indicated bond preparation area.

features.name: Right end face and chamfers
features.description: Flat face at the right extremity of the pin with green color coding note and 3X edge chamfers.

features.name: Right coaxial threaded bore
features.description: Blind internal hole tapped from the right face, consisting of a .578 tap drill and .625-18 UNF-2B thread.

relationships.detail: The external-thread major diameter has a position control referencing Datum A.
The tapered surface has a runout control referencing Datum A.
The taper is rotationally controlled about the cylindrical Datum A axis by the runout requirement.
The external thread and main cylindrical body share the longitudinal pin centerline.
The annular thread relief lies at the end of the external-thread segment about the same longitudinal axis.
The left entry chamfer surrounds the end of the external thread.
The circumferential shoulder fillet blends the large end of the taper into the cylindrical body about the pin centerline.
The right threaded bore is explicitly described as coaxial with the pin body.
The permissible center hole is centered on the primary longitudinal pin axis.
The right terminal flat face is normal to the longitudinal cylinder axis; this is a geometric relationship, not an extracted perpendicularity tolerance.
The blind threaded bore opens through the right terminal face.

datums.description: Outer cylindrical surface of the Ø1.955/1.945 main body

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: A is the sole defined datum and establishes the primary longitudinal axis. The external-thread position control and tapered-surface runout control both reference A. No secondary or tertiary datum is defined.

assumptions.text: Grouped main_view:F3 with detail_optional_undercut:F1 using the explicit optional-undercut detail reference. They describe alternative implementations of the same relief location, not two separate grooves.

Selected main_view:F3 as canonical and as the default production design because it provides the main-view toleranced relief definition. The optional-detail requirements are alternative-design requirements and must not be imposed cumulatively on the main-view relief.

Retained end_view:F1 as a standalone permissible manufacturing-center feature rather than merging it with main_view:F8. The end view does not identify which end carries the permissible center, and it does not establish identity with the threaded bore. No mandatory center-hole dimensions are requested because centers are expressly permissible.

The extraction notes explicitly identify inch dimensions stored directly in fields named *_mm. These source numbers are preserved without conversion during merging and require inch-aware downstream handling.
Retained main_view:F7 as the supplied compound face-and-chamfer observation. Its face count does not override the explicit 3X chamfer qualifier, and no spatial chamfer pattern is inferred.

No separate usable-thread-length clarification is raised for main_view:F2: FULL THREAD identifies the threaded segment, and its axial extent is constrained by the extracted segment and relief dimensions.

The bond preparation is governed by the callout '* BOND PREP THIS AREA ALL AROUND' applied circumferentially over the 2.870–2.890 inch axial length of the Ø1.955–1.945 cylinder, conforming to the indicated 125 microinch surface finish.
